arabic text: YA IMAME RAZA DO SAHARA HAMNE THAMA HAI DAAMAN TUMHARA
english translation text: O IMAM RAZA, AID US, WE ARE KNOCKING ON YOUR DOOR

arabic text: HAM KO ROZE PE JALDI BULANA HAMNE THAMA HAI DAAMAN
english translation text: CALL US TO YOUR SHRINE, WE ARE KNOCKING ON YOUR DOOR

arabic text: YA IMAME RAZA SABKI SUNLO, TUMSE MAANGENGE KYA VO BHI SUNLO\nDAR DEKHADO SABHI KO TUMHARA\nHAMNE THAAMA HAI DAAMAN TUMHARA
english translation text: O IMAM RAZA, LISTEN TO US ALL, WE ARE\nGOING TO ASK FROM YOU OUR DESIRES SHOW US\nALL YOUR SHRINE, WE ARE KNOCKING ON YOUR DOOR

arabic text: JO HAI BEEMAR UNKO SHIFA DO, JAULIYAN SAB KI BHARDO KHUDARA\nJAAM SE HAR MARIZO KO PILANA,\nHAMNDE THAAMA HAI DAAMAN TUMHARA
english translation text: CURE WHOEVER IS ILL, FULFIL EVERYONE’S DESIRES, LET\nEVERY SICK PERSON DRINK FROM YOUR FOUNTAIN OF\nHEALTH, WE ARE KNOCKING ON YOUR DOOR

arabic text: WASTA AKBARE NAUJAWAN KA, WASTA CHE MAHINE KI JAAN KA\nKAR DO RAHMAT KO BAS AB ISHARA, HAMNE THAAMA HAI DAAMAN TUMHARA
english translation text: FOR THE SAKE OF THE YOUTHFUL ALI AKBER, FOR THE SAKE OF THE SIX MONTH\nOLD BABY, SHOW US THAT WE HAVE YOUR BLESSINGS, WE ARE KNOCKING ON YOUR DOOR
